title: After the Takamatsunomiya Kinen: New Me, New Dreams

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: There are still some things I want to work on, but I get a good result! I'm sure I can improve even more.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: After some discussion with Trainer, we decide that I should run in the Milers Cup next.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: If I keep doing well in races, Trainer might even get an award from the URA! Hehe. I have a new dream now… ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll be running against Zephyr again in my next race. She's hit a wall in terms of race distance and is struggling to overcome it. I'm worried about her…
